facts.text: Jon expressed enthusiasm about attending a dance class with Gina.

evidence.quote: Wow, great idea! Let's go to a dance class, it'll be so much fun!

facts.text: Gina and Jon both expressed interest in exploring contemporary dance.

evidence.quote: Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.
